title: Sermon on the Mount: Judging and The Two Foundations

questions.question: How does Jesus say you will be judged?
options: "For with the judgment you pronounce you will be judged, and with the measure you use it will be measured to you."
questions.correctAnswer: "For with the judgment you pronounce you will be judged, and with the measure you use it will be measured to you."
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:2 (ESV): "For with the judgment you pronounce you will be judged, and with the measure you use it will be measured to you."

questions.question: What object does Jesus say is in your own eye when you try to take the speck out of your brother's eye?
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:3 (ESV): "Why do you see the speck that is in your brother's eye, but do not notice the log that is in your own eye?"

questions.question: What animals does Jesus mention when cautioning against giving what is holy to the unholy?
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:6 (ESV): "Do not give dogs what is holy, and do not throw your pearls before pigs, lest they trample them underfoot and turn to attack you."

questions.question: Complete the trio of imperatives: "Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; ______"
options: knock, and it will be opened to you
pray, and the Lord will answer
wait, and your strength will be renewed
questions.correctAnswer: knock, and it will be opened to you
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:7 (ESV): "Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you."

questions.question: Jesus asks, if a son asks for bread from his father, will the father give him a what?
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:9 (ESV): "Or which one of you, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?"

questions.question: What is often called the "Golden Rule" in Matthew 7:12, summarizing the Law and the Prophets?
options: "Whatever you wish that others would do to you, do also to them"
"Love the Lord your God with all your heart"
questions.correctAnswer: "Whatever you wish that others would do to you, do also to them"
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:12 (ESV): "So whatever you wish that others would do to you, do also to them, for this is the Law and the Prophets."

questions.question: What kind of gate does Jesus tell us to enter by, because the alternate gate to destruction is wide?
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:13 (ESV): "Enter by the narrow gate. For the gate is wide and the way is easy that leads to destruction, and those who enter by it are many."

questions.question: How does Jesus describe false prophets who come in sheep's clothing?
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:15 (ESV): "Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves."

questions.question: How will you recognize these false prophets?
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:16 (ESV): "You will recognize them by their fruits. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?"

questions.question: What happens to every tree that does not bear good fruit?
options: It is cut down and thrown into the fire
It is uprooted by the wind
It is cursed to wither forever
questions.correctAnswer: It is cut down and thrown into the fire
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:19 (ESV): "Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire."

questions.question: Will everyone who says "Lord, Lord" enter the kingdom of heaven?
options: No, but the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven
Yes, for the Lord is merciful to all who call Him
Only if they sold their possessions
Only if they were baptized by John
questions.correctAnswer: No, but the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:21 (ESV): "Not everyone who says to me, 'Lord, Lord,' will enter the kingdom of heaven, but the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven."

questions.question: Many will point to their works (prophesying, casting out demons, mighty works) on that day, but what will Jesus declare to them?
options: "I never knew you; depart from me, you workers of lawlessness."
"You did these for your own glory."
questions.correctAnswer: "I never knew you; depart from me, you workers of lawlessness."
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:23 (ESV): "And then will I declare to them, 'I never knew you; depart from me, you workers of lawlessness.'"

questions.question: In the parable of the two builders, what makes the wise man wise?
options: He hears the words of Jesus and does them
He learns many different building techniques
He buys the most expensive materials
questions.correctAnswer: He hears the words of Jesus and does them
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:24 (ESV): "Everyone then who hears these words of mine and does them will be like a wise man who built his house on the rock."

questions.question: When the rain, floods, and winds beat against the house of the foolish man (built on sand), what happened?
options: It fell, and great was the fall of it
It lost its roof but the walls stood
It was washed down to the sea entirely
questions.correctAnswer: It fell, and great was the fall of it
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:27 (ESV): "And the rain fell, and the floods came, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell, and great was the fall of it."

questions.question: When Jesus finished these sayings, why were the crowds astonished at His teaching?
options: For he was teaching them as one who had authority, and not as their scribes
Because of the miracles He performed between sermons
Because He quoted the scriptures accurately from memory
Because His voice was so loud it echoed down the mountain
questions.correctAnswer: For he was teaching them as one who had authority, and not as their scribes
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:28-29 (ESV): "And when Jesus finished these sayings, the crowds were astonished at his teaching, for he was teaching them as one who had authority, and not as their scribes."

key_verse_text: "Everyone then who hears these words of mine and does them will be like a wise man who built his house on the rock."
